title: AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.02276v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. Given a dataset and a task, it surveys the literature, parses the data, identifies relevant baselines, and formulates a model hypothesis through critic-mediated discussion among agents specialized in data modeling, single-cell biology

translated_title: 用于构建虚拟细胞模型的AI科学家
translated_abstract: 从虚拟实验室到生物数据分析智能体和“共同科学家”，自主智能体已经开始将科学目标转化为假设。然而，它们能否更进一步，将真实的、含噪声的、复杂的生物数据转化为可执行的模型假设以及编码了可检验假设的模型架构，仍不清楚。预测细胞如何响应基因和化学扰动是对这种能力的一个天然测试：这一任务对解读疾病机制和治疗发现至关重要，但需要极少能集中于单一研究团队的跨学科专业知识。在此，我们介绍CellForge——一个用于单细胞扰动建模的有组织自主智能体团队。给定一个数据集和一项任务，它会调研文献、解析数据、识别相关基线方法，并通过专门负责数据建模、单细胞生物学等领域的智能体之间由批评者中介的讨论，形成模型假设。
tldr: 本文提出CellForge，一个由多个自主智能体组成的有组织团队，能够将真实复杂的单细胞扰动数据自动转化为可执行的模型假设与架构，实现了从文献调研、数据分析到模型构建的全流程自动化AI科学家系统。
en_tdlr: CellForge, an organized team of autonomous AI agents, automatically converts real, noisy single-cell perturbation data into executable model hypotheses and architectures, automating the full scientific workflow from literature survey to model building for virtual-cell modeling.
